description: German gas station fuel prices near a location — Benzinpreise Germany, real-time from the official MTS-K feed. Find the cheapest diesel, E5, or E10 near a point in Germany with price in EUR per liter, brand, address, distance, and open status. Coordinates are required: geocode a German city or address first (e.g. via a geocoding tool) — Berlin is lat 52.52, lng 13.40. Data covers Germany only. Example: tankerkoenig_stations_nearby({ latitude: 52.52, longitude: 13.40, radius_km: 5, fuel: "diesel", sort: "price" })

_apiKey.description: Optional: your own free Tankerkoenig API key (creativecommons.tankerkoenig.de)

fuel.description: Fuel type: "e5" (Super 95), "e10" (Super E10), "diesel", or "all" for all three prices per station (default "all")

latitude.description: Latitude of the search center (Germany), e.g. 52.52 for Berlin

longitude.description: Longitude of the search center (Germany), e.g. 13.40 for Berlin

open_only.description: Return only stations that are currently open (default false)

radius_km.description: Search radius in kilometers (default 5, maximum 25 — larger values are clamped)

sort.description: Sort order: "distance" (default) or "price" (cheapest first). Sorting by price requires a single fuel type (e5, e10, or diesel), the API rejects sort by price when fuel is "all"

name: tankerkoenig_stations_nearby
title: Tankerkoenig Stations Nearby
